convertWindowsTranslitteration

public static java.lang.String convertWindowsTranslitteration(java.lang.String entry)
Converts a translitteration written using the mapping used in the Utrecht fonts into proper Manuel de Codage.

It seems quite a few users tend to use non-standard MdC for uppercase letters.

The corresponding codes for upper case are:

  • h = !
  • H = @
  • x = #
  • X = £
  • s = %
  • S = ^ ; quite impossible in a MdC file.
  • t = &
  • T = § or *
  • d = ?
  • D = + ; quite impossible in a MdC file.
  • s with spirit = c

Parameters:
entry - : a string using the encoding of Utrecht's translitteration fonts
Returns:
proper MdC translitteration, with ^ for uppercase.
